text:
nina: Hey folks — flying out of SAN tonight, 9:30pm. Any quick grab-and-go recs in Gaslamp so I can eat before the flight? Flight check-in already a pain :sweat_smile:
claire: Oscar's Mexican has the best fish tacos, 4th & K. Opens late-ish and super fast. cash or card. :taco:
sam: If you want something lighter, High Street Poke is 3 blocks from the office and does bowls-to-go in under 10. reusable bowls if you care.
raj: For super quick + portable: Basic Bar & Bread deli sandwiches on 5th. Walk out with a wrap and you're golden.
jules: Pro tip: if security lines at SAN are long, grab something from Filippi's Pizza on Island Ave — big slices, easy to eat on the plane. :pizza:
foodbot: FYI — Gaslamp parking is free after 7pm on most streets per city-parking-bot (link: https://sd.gov/parking).
claire: Also there's the Little Italy trolley market but that's 10min by Uber. great if you have time and want artisanal stuff.
nina: This is awesome — thank you! I hate eating in the airport overpriced stuff. any spots that wrap well?
sam: Oscar's tacos wrap decently. Also the deli wrap from Basic Bar is fully sealed in foil — plane-friendly.
raj: If you like spicy, try the Korean BBQ taco at Taco Fusion on 5th. spicy but not messy.
jules: If anyone else is flying tonight from SAN and wants to meetup quick for a slice, ping me. I'll be at the office until 6:15.
claire: quick vote — tacos :thumbsup:, poke :laughing:, pizza :heart:, sandwich :rocket:
nina: tacos for the win. heading out early to grab one. thanks y'all! :raising_hand:
sam: safe travels! send a pic if you can.
foodbot: Reminder: Office kitchen closes at 6:00 PM. Pack any leftovers.
